summary: Larry Ellison, Oracle's billionaire cofounder, told investors that AI will enable a comprehensive surveillance system, ensuring citizens behave well by constantly recording and reporting. He envisions AI monitoring police and citizens, with drones replacing police cars in chases. Oracle is pursuing AI opportunities, including a partnership with SpaceX.

claims.text: Larry Ellison said AI will ensure 'citizens will be on their best behavior' through constant surveillance.
claims.evidence_quote: Citizens will be on their best behavior because we are constantly recording and reporting everything that's going on.

claims.text: Ellison expects AI to supervise police officers at all times, with AI reporting any problems to appropriate personnel.
claims.evidence_quote: Every police officer is going to be supervised at all times, and if there's a problem, AI will report that problem and report it to the appropriate person.

claims.text: Ellison predicts AI drones will replace police cars in high-speed chases.
claims.evidence_quote: You just have a drone follow the car. It's very simple in the age of autonomous drones.

claims.text: Ellison made these comments during an Oracle financial analysts meeting earlier this week.
claims.evidence_quote: Ellison made the comments as he spoke to investors earlier this week during an Oracle financial analysts meeting

claims.text: Oracle is pursuing AI opportunities, including a partnership with Elon Musk's SpaceX.
claims.evidence_quote: It already has several projects in the works, including one in partnership with Elon Musk's SpaceX.

claims.text: Larry Ellison is the world's sixth-richest man with a net worth of $157 billion.
claims.evidence_quote: Ellison is the world's sixth-richest man with a net worth of $157 billion, according to Bloomberg.

claims.text: Ellison's daughter Megan Ellison founded Annapurna Pictures in 2011.
claims.evidence_quote: His daughter Megan Ellison founded her production company Annapurna Pictures in 2011

claims.text: Ellison's son David Ellison is set to become CEO of Paramount after its merger with Skydance Media.
claims.evidence_quote: his son David Ellison is set to become CEO of Paramount after it completes its merger with Skydance Media.
